'''Okalin''' was a [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] assistant and advisor to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Okalin became Sanjay's royal advisor at around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], after he had taken the throne from [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], the former king of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. With a network of contacts spread throughout the walled city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], Okalin was able to stay abreast of the shifting tides of fears and sympathy that gripped the Onderonian citizens during the Clone Wars. Okalin thought of warning [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|"terrorist strikes"]] that threatened his life, but the even-tempered advisor was careful not to provoke the ire of the king or his war leaders.

Okalin was with Rash both when he was conferring with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and when he was threatening [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] by execution, who was secretly conspiring with the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].

Okalin was also with Rash when he was arguing with [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] and [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]].

After failing to end the rebel movement's gaining of the public affiliation, Okalin was present when Dooku announced to support Rash and his affiliates no longer and Kalani killed the King of Onderon. Okalin quickly raised his hands, not wanting to suffer the same fate.
